content: In this work, we introduced a model for forecasting conversational events that processes comments as they happen and takes the full conversational context into account to make an updated prediction at each step. This model fills a void in the existing literature on conversational forecasting, simultaneously addressing the dual challenges of capturing inter-comment dynamics and dealing with an unknown horizon. We find that our model achieves state-of-the-art performance on the task of forecasting derailment in two different datasets that we release publicly. We further show that the resulting system can provide substantial prior notice of derailment, opening up the potential for preemptive interventions by human moderators BIBREF65.
